_note: Manual step: add the 'mcpServers' block below into your project-scoped .mcp.json or into ~/.claude/mcp_config.json. Do NOT paste into ~/.claude/settings.json.

usage.project_scoped: Create or edit .mcp.json at your project root and paste the mcpServers block.
usage.global: Add the mcpServers block to ~/.claude/mcp_config.json (not settings.json).
usage.verify: claude mcp list  # should show 'altevra' as connected
